newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss shares seen firmer, UBS up in pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Swiss shares seen firmer, UBS up in pre-bourse.

text.p: 0730 GMT - Swiss shares are expected to open stronger in a technical reaction to yesterday's losses, with UBS up some 1.2 percent firmer in pre-bourse trade after the bank said group net rose 67.4 percent int the first half, at the top of analysts' expectations.
Follow-through buying, however, is necessary to hold the opening gains, dealers added.
Stocks like CS Group, Novartis and Roche, which were strongly hit yesterday, were sought in pre-bourse trade.
A SMI index, calculated by Bank Leu on pre-bourse prices, was 40.3 points firmer at 5,811.3.

Dealers said UBS half-year figures were good and at the top of expectations, which ranged between nearly 50 percent and 70 percent. But one trader said the rise of trading income of only one percent was disappointing.
On the other hand, commission income was better than expected, the dealer added.
UBS said earlier that net trading income was depressed by a 52 percent drop in equity trading income due to unsatisfactory results in equity derivatives, where value adjustements had been made.
